hooks.name: Check frontend TypeScript on save
hooks.description: Runs eslint (--max-warnings=0) on the saved frontend/src/*.ts(x) file, then tsc --noEmit for the frontend project (tsc cannot check a single file inside a project). Tools come from EVIDENCE_PROGRAMS_ROOT via configs/development-toolchain.json and frontend/node_modules, never from PATH. Result PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED goes to stdout and .agents/hook-logs/kiro-hooks.log. Kiro fires PostFileSave for editor saves and for agent writes, so no PostToolUse hook is needed.
